chunks: As for what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, he said:
Every salat (prayer) that you left due to an illness in which you lost consciousness, then make it up when you recover consciousness.

key_terms.فَاقْضِهِ: then make it up as qada'

ai.seo_question: Must a person make up salat (prayer) missed while unconscious due to illness?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning missed salat (prayer) during a period of unconsciousness caused by illness. It instructs that such prayers are to be performed later as qada' once the person regains consciousness.
